source: #751: the pads' input delays, each bit given to the one pad whose kind and delay it follows (ana-paddly.mjs), from the designs implemented by ISE 14.7 (xdl -xdl2ncd, bitgen) in which each pad is used on its own: unused, an output, an input register with each IFD_DELAY_VALUE, a direct input with each IBUF_DELAY_VALUE (gen-paddly.mjs, gen-pairdly.mjs); only the features that differ from the database #44 / #97 solved are listed
